items.title: "I hate gay Halloween": the feed dresses up as its own memes
items.summary: Halloween on X turned into gay Halloween, the yearly contest to dress as a reference so specific only the extremely online get it, posted as "I hate gay Halloween, what do you mean you're...". Friday night set the bar with "the whore mirror from Black Swan," a lipstick-scrawled mirror worn as a costume (354K likes, 9.9M views), and RuPaul's conversion-camp counselor from But I'm a Cheerleader (187K). On Halloween night @blonddtyler leapt down a stairwell in an orange wig and teal shirt as Lois Griffin falling down the stairs ("howd i do?", 208K, 5.9M views), and the year's own moments became costumes too, from Molly, the $15,000 bird in Kelly Clarkson's toy-shop feud, to a man lying with his torso through a tennis racket: "the best last minute Halloween costume ever."
items.author: @adrnvic
